mentions.name: blobsearch
mentions.description: This is a zero-ops, S3-based log search tool that serves as a cheap alternative to CloudWatch and similar cloud logging services, avoiding vendor dependence and extra cloud costs.
mentions.problem: CloudWatch and comparable logging services are expensive and create dependence on cloud providers, so a cheaper alternative was needed.
mentions.audience: Needed a cheap alternative to CloudWatch and other cloud logging services without paying the "cloud tax" or depending on them.
mentions.source_excerpt: Zero ops S3 based log search: https://github.com/amr8t/blobsearch
